title: Quaternion kinematics for the error-state Kalman filter
summary: Long tutorial report covering quaternion conventions, rotation perturbations and their derivatives, and a full derivation of an IMU-driven error-state Kalman filter including the reset step.
key_takeaways: Pins down Hamilton vs JPL quaternion conventions
Step-by-step ESKF prediction, correction and reset
Global vs local error definitions

title: A micro Lie theory for state estimation in robotics
summary: Compact introduction to the subset of Lie theory needed for estimation: exp/log maps, plus/minus operators, adjoints and Jacobians on common groups.
key_takeaways: Unified plus/minus notation for manifold states
Ready-to-use Jacobians for SO(3), SE(3) and others

title: Principles of GNSS, Inertial, and Multisensor Integrated Navigation Systems, Second Edition
summary: Standard reference on satellite, inertial and terrestrial radio navigation and their integration, including INS/GNSS integration architectures, dead reckoning, feature matching and integrity monitoring.
key_takeaways: Loose, tight and deep INS/GNSS coupling explained
Covers fault detection and integrity
Companion MATLAB simulation software for buyers

title: Strapdown Inertial Navigation Technology, 2nd Edition
summary: Classic IET text on strapdown inertial navigation: sensor technologies, mechanisation, error propagation and compensation, and aided navigation.
key_takeaways: Physical principles and error growth of INS
Sensor technology from mechanical gyros to MEMS

title: State Estimation for Robotics (Second Edition)
summary: Textbook on probabilistic estimation for robotics, from linear-Gaussian filtering and batch estimation to matrix Lie groups for 3D pose; the second edition adds variational inference and inertial navigation material. Author hosts a PDF; print edition from Cambridge University Press.
key_takeaways: Batch vs recursive estimation from first principles
Matrix Lie groups for pose and uncertainty
New inertial navigation section in 2nd edition

title: Factor Graphs for Robot Perception
summary: Monograph (Foundations and Trends in Robotics) introducing factor graphs for SLAM and estimation, sparse linear algebra behind them, and incremental smoothing.
key_takeaways: Why sparsity makes smoothing tractable
From batch to incremental (iSAM) inference

title: iSAM2: Incremental Smoothing and Mapping Using the Bayes Tree
summary: Introduces the Bayes tree and the iSAM2 algorithm for incremental nonlinear smoothing with fluid relinearization, the engine behind GTSAM's online estimators.
key_takeaways: Incremental updates without periodic batch steps
Bayes tree data structure

title: On-Manifold Preintegration for Real-Time Visual-Inertial Odometry
summary: Derives IMU preintegration on the SO(3) manifold with bias-correction Jacobians, enabling IMU factors between keyframes in factor-graph optimization.
key_takeaways: Summarise many IMU samples into one relative-motion factor
First-order bias correction avoids re-integration

title: The invariant extended Kalman filter as a stable observer
summary: Foundational paper showing that for group-affine systems the invariant EKF has error dynamics independent of the trajectory, giving stability guarantees standard EKFs lack.
key_takeaways: Error defined on the Lie group, not in vector space
Better consistency under large initial errors

title: Contact-Aided Invariant Extended Kalman Filtering for Robot State Estimation
summary: Applies the invariant EKF to legged robots, fusing IMU with leg contact kinematics, and evaluates it against a quaternion EKF.
key_takeaways: Contact points as extra states in the group
Faster convergence than quaternion EKF

title: AI-IMU Dead-Reckoning
summary: Car localisation from IMU alone by combining an invariant EKF with a neural network that adapts measurement noise covariances (pseudo-measurements), evaluated on KITTI.
key_takeaways: Learned covariances, classical filter structure
IMU-only ground vehicle dead reckoning

title: TLIO: Tight Learned Inertial Odometry
summary: Combines a network that predicts displacement and uncertainty from IMU data with an EKF, for pedestrian inertial odometry.
key_takeaways: Learned measurement plus learned uncertainty in a filter

title: RoNIN: Robust Neural Inertial Navigation in the Wild: Benchmark, Evaluations, and New Methods
summary: Introduces a large smartphone IMU dataset with ground truth and benchmarks neural architectures for pedestrian velocity regression.
key_takeaways: Benchmark dataset for learned pedestrian navigation
Body-frame heading-agnostic representation

title: AirIO: Learning Inertial Odometry with Enhanced IMU Feature Observability
summary: UAV-focused learned inertial odometry that changes how IMU data are represented to the network to make motion features more observable.
key_takeaways: IMU-only odometry for drones
Representation choice matters for UAV learned IO

title: Kalibr wiki: IMU Noise Model
summary: Practical explanation of white noise and random-walk bias parameters for IMUs, how to convert datasheet values to continuous/discrete form and how to inflate them for real use.
key_takeaways: Continuous vs discrete noise density conversion
Inflate Allan-derived noise for real-world use

title: Factor Graphs and GTSAM: A Hands-on Introduction
summary: Official GTSAM tutorial walking through factor graph modelling with odometry, landmark and pose-graph examples in C++ and Python.
key_takeaways: Best first hour with GTSAM

title: An efficient orientation filter for inertial and inertial/magnetic sensor arrays
summary: Internal report introducing the gradient-descent orientation filter now known as the Madgwick filter, for IMU and MARG sensors.
key_takeaways: Low computational cost attitude filter
Single tuning parameter
